abort.already_configured: Every Rain Bird controller is already extended.
abort.no_rainbird: Set up the Rain Bird integration first, then add Rain Bird Extended.

user.title: Rain Bird Extended
user.description: Choose the Rain Bird controller to add valves, valve runtimes and time remaining to.

data.disable_rainbird_switches: Disable the Rain Bird zone switches

data_description.disable_rainbird_switches: Each zone's valve replaces its Rain Bird switch, so the switches are disabled to avoid having every zone twice (for example in HomeKit). Turn this off to keep both.

run_all_zones_section.name: Run all zones and cycle and soak

data.run_all_zones: Run all zones: zones and order

data_description.run_all_zones: Pick the zones to run, then drag them into the order to run them. Leave empty to run every zone in zone order.
data_description.cycle_minutes: Run all zones (and start_zone with cycle and soak) split each zone's run into cycles of at most this long, taking turns between zones. 0 turns cycle and soak off.
data_description.soak_minutes: The least time each zone rests between its cycles.

blowout_section.name: Blowout sprinklers
blowout_section.description: For winterizing with an air compressor.

data_description.blowout_zones: Pick the zones to blow out, then drag them into order. Leave empty for every zone in zone order.
data_description.blowout_cycles: How many times each zone is opened.
data_description.blowout_on_minutes: How long each burst runs. Rain Bird runs zones in whole minutes.
data_description.blowout_rest_seconds: Pause after every burst (also between zones) so the compressor can recover.

data_description.weather_entity: Pick a weather entity to add the Rain skip, Freeze skip and Weather adjustment switches.
data_description.rain_check_time: Rain skip, freeze skip and weather adjustment all check at this time each day. Pick a time before your programs start.

rain_skip_section.name: Rain skip
rain_skip_section.description: Sets the controller's rain delay when today's forecast is wet enough.

data.rain_chance: Skip when the chance of rain is at least

data_description.rain_chance: Compared with today's precipitation probability. Forecasts without one count as wet when the condition is rainy.
data_description.rain_delay_days: Only raised, never shortened, if a longer rain delay is already set.

freeze_skip_section.name: Freeze skip
freeze_skip_section.description: Sets the controller's rain delay when today's forecast low is freezing, and with a temperature sensor also stops watering whenever it reads freezing. Blowouts are never stopped.

data_description.freeze_temperature: Compared with today's forecast low and the temperature sensor.
data_description.freeze_sensor: An outdoor temperature sensor. With one, freeze skip works without a weather forecast too.
data_description.freeze_delay_days: Only raised, never shortened, if a longer rain delay is already set.

weather_adjustment_section.name: Weather adjustment
weather_adjustment_section.description: Sets every program's seasonal adjustment from today's forecast high: the low percent at or below the low temperature, the high percent at or above the high temperature, and in between in a straight line (rounded to 5%). Needs Home Assistant 2026.10 or newer. Its switch starts off.

data.adjust_low_percent: Seasonal adjustment at the low temperature
data.adjust_high_percent: Seasonal adjustment at the high temperature

start_zone.name: Start zone
start_zone.description: Runs a zone once for a set time, without changing its valve runtime.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to run the zone. Rain Bird runs zones in whole minutes.

cycle_and_soak.name: Cycle and soak
cycle_and_soak.description: Split the run into cycles with soaks between them, using the cycle and soak times from the options.

blowout.name: Blowout sprinklers
blowout.description: Winterize with an air compressor: open each zone in short bursts with a rest after each one, one zone after another. Fields left out use the Blowout settings in the options.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Zone numbers to blow out, in order. Leave out for the zones in the options.

cycles.name: Bursts per zone
cycles.description: How many times each zone is opened.

on_time.name: Burst length
on_time.description: How long each burst runs, in whole minutes.

rest.name: Rest
rest.description: Pause after every burst, including between zones.

confirm.title: Remove {title}?
confirm.description: The Rain Bird integration entry that {title} extends was removed, so its valves and other entities can't work.\n\nIf you set up Rain Bird again, remove {title} and add Rain Bird Extended again for the new controller. Select **Submit** to remove {title} now.
